data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word foruz, meaning 'victory' or 'triumph'. Forouzan is a name of great significance in Persian and Islamic cultures, symbolizing the triumph of good over evil. The name Forouzan carries the meaning “Victory, Triumph” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Forouzan usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, triumph and live with faith, good character and purpose.
